{{Quote|I was in a remote part of the Outer Rim, where we were escorting a small fleet of prototype warships on what should have been a secret route.|Grand Master Satele Shan recounts the Battle of Hoth|<ref name="Gnost" />}}
A '''fleet''' of prototype warships was gathered by the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] for an upcoming attack on the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] in [[3665 BBY]]. Led by the [[superdreadnaught]] ''[[Star of Coruscant]]'', the [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] included ships such as the ''[[Vehement Sword]]'' and the ''[[Sendant Pride]]'', and it was being escorted by additional Republic warships near the [[Hoth system/Legends|Hoth system]] when it was ambushed by the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy]]. The resulting [[Battle of Hoth (Great Galactic War)|Battle of Hoth]] lasted for days and crossed through several [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] before reaching its peak above the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], where most of both fleets were destroyed and the Republic's commander [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Laren Omas]] [[Death/Legends|killed]]. Most of the prototype ships, including the ''Star of Coruscant'', crashed to the planet's surface.
